bundle.shortDescription: Debloat your Android TV and dress its launcher, from your desktop.
bundle.longDescription: CleanYourTV Desktop talks to an Android TV or Google TV over ADB: it backs up first, disables only what the project's safety rules allow, pushes launcher themes, browses the TV's files and takes screenshots.
